opex.text: Operating expenses. Total operating expenses for the three months ended August 31, 2026 were $44,024, compared to $19,229 for the three months ended August 31, 2025, an increase of $24,795. The increase was primarily attributable to server rental expense of $8,400 and research and development expense of $5,040 related to the operation and development of the API, both of which were not incurred in the comparative period, an increase in professional fees of $5,947 and an increase in amortization expense of $5,382 resulting from software refactoring costs, website development costs and API development costs placed in service after August 31, 2025. Professional fees of $14,473 consisted primarily of audit and review fees, technical support consulting, transfer agent and legal fees.

ocf.text: Cash from operating activities. Net cash provided by operating activities for the three months ended August 31, 2026 was $10,649, compared to net cash used in operating activities of $8,602 for the three months ended August 31, 2025. The change reflects cash collected from API subscriptions in advance of the subscription periods (an increase in deferred revenue of $10,720), partially offset by the net loss adjusted for non-cash amortization and an increase in prepaid expenses of $4,400.

wc.text: Our liabilities as of August 31, 2026 consisted of accounts payable of $347, deferred revenue of $28,810, a promissory note payable of $163,000 maturing on November 14, 2026, and a related party loan payable of $163,584 owed to our CEO and director. The available capital reserves of the Company are not sufficient for the Company to remain operational. The Company depends on continued financial support from its CEO and director under the Loan Agreement described in Note 8 to the financial statements, on revenues from API subscriptions and on its ability to raise additional capital.

intro.text: Elventix Technology Corporation ("Elventix ", the "Company", "we", "us" or "our") was incorporated under the laws of the State of Wyoming, U.S. on March 4, 2025 (Inception). The Company is an early-stage technology company focused on the development and commercialization of "Smarterest," a mobile news aggregation and content-curation application. The application is designed to aggregate and deliver current news content, with functionality supporting personalized information delivery. In addition, the Company offers subscription-based access to an API that provides a selection of news sources, which are personalized and filtered. The Company's objective is to improve access to timely and relevant information while minimizing non-essential or excessive content.
